name: Bonkus
text: Bonkus once dwelled the circus grounds of Laughingmen entertainment, but a traumatic event led him to leave the grounds. Now he lives in the swamp area, and sometimes has a chat with fellow misfit Lou Baba

name: Lou Baba
text: Lou Baba was too tall for his dwarf tribe, and too short for normal society. When he applied to the circus as a musician, he was only offered a freak role. Out of principle, he declined, and now lives as musician and drugdealer in the swamp district. He sometimes talks to Bonkus, and deals drugs to Frenzy

name: Frenzy
text: Frenzy and Avani once worked for the same fey in the feywild, when a job gone wrong got them banished to the material plane. Both fey blame each other, but still live in the same city they arrived in. Frenzy has a fancy for drugs, and buys from Lou Baba

name: Avani
text: Avani and Frenzy both blame each other for their banishment to Crescent Hills. She used to live in the feywild, but now she lives in the farmlands of the rich folk of the city. Recently she has noticed the large amount of rot in the farmfields, and wants to find out where it comes from.

name: Adalin Darkfeather
text:
Edalyne is a kenku who is born and raised in Olde Town but she lost her parents at a young age and because of that she had to make duo with what the city provided as well as using her talents to keep living.
Duo to her kenku bloodline she has the skill to duplicate writings and made that her bread and butter by slowly stealing money from rich people through checks and what not which builded her funds to buy a house in Olde Town while having a comfortable life.
To learn more about the chaos in the city and potentially get to know who might have killed her parents she visits the library often, she also does this to esxape the noisy streets and sometimes the library isn't enough and choses to go to the swamp for more quietness

name: Silas Ravencroft
text: Silas Ravenscroft, the first Count of Crescent Hills, used his own Castle, Crescent Keep, as an asylum for the mentally unwell. Years later, after a visit from the at the time king, the asylum burned down with everyone inside, including the count.

name: Robbert Blackwood
text: Robert Blackwood is the charismatic head of the city watch, and reasonably wealthy. People are not sure of the man is very naive, working for someone, or has a plan of his own. But he sure as hell doesn't look after the city.

name: Addelard Nelson
text: Lord Nelson is a mindflayer, and uses this to communicate with a small security force of mind flayers inside of Harbour district. He works for the large global Anchor Corporation, and is focused on the company's goals.

name: Felix Lionheart
text: Felix Lionheart is a charming recluse and something of a lady killer. He oversees the lighthouse every night, though he is almost never alone while doing so. Despite his charming nature, there is something about Felix that seems to make all Mindflayers working for the Anchor Corporation avoid him.

name: Maximilian Faust
text: Baron Faust despises the factories he owns, and the workers fear whenever he enters their district. To them, he is their god, controlling their pay, housing, and very livelihoods. He is a cruel man, focused almost entirely on quotas and efficiency.

name: Arthur Marrow
role: Head Priest of the Perfect Body
text:
Father Marrow is the head priest of the People's Church of the Perfect Body. Normally a calm and composed man, he transforms into a passionate preacher of pure belief whenever he delivers his sermons.

Recently The name Arthur Marrow was mentioned in the Eagle's Hope Reports, as the name of the court doctor 200 years ago during King Hemmath's Rule. His name also appeared as the name of a chariot train station in the castle under Eagle's Hope.

name: Mikah Crowe
text: Mikah Crowe is a mysterious man who dislikes people, public speaking, and attention. Despite this, the incredibly wealthy head of House Crowe is known to donate generously to libraries, museums, and orphanages throughout the city.

name: Julia Graveseal
text: Julia Graveseal is the head librarian of the largest library in the city. She is a mysterious woman, not because she is shy, but because she is almost always busy archiving and organizing lore of an arcane and esoteric nature. She can often be found locked away in her office, surrounded by ancient knowledge.

name: Nikoleta Crowe
text: Nikki Crowe was pronounced dead by her wealthy family, only to reappear years later in the city, married to Fierre Laughingman and running an entertainment organization. Despite her public life, her biological family continues to insist that she is dead.

name: Fierre Laughingman
text: Fierre Laughingman is a mysterious man whose past is almost entirely unknown. He appeared in the city alongside his wife, Nikki Crowe, and together they built a vast entertainment empire. Fierre is always smiling and seems to be an exceptionally happy man.

name: Jarred Amherst
text: The Inspector shows up, and everything goes wrong. Nobody knows what kind of inspector Jarred Amherst actually is, but wherever he goes, men have died and businesses have been destroyed. Whatever his purpose may be, everyone knows one thing: pray he does not introduce himself to you.

name: Ogura Bloodstone
text: Known as the Blue Hunter, Ogura Bloodstone is the head of the Blue Rose chapter in Crescent Hills. With a kill count most likely numbering in the thousands after his exceptionally long life, he is considered one of the most deadly people in the city. If you can afford his services, the job will get done.

name: Medio Gato
text: Medio Gato is one of the more important figures in Crescent Hills. A private investigator with knowledge of the coming end of the world, he seeks to help the party and their allies prevent it. Medio runs his own investigation office, which can serve as a home base for the party throughout their journey.

name: Maxeridius
text: Max is the cousin of Sigismund, and together with him works for the Order of the Black Cloak.

name: Bippo
role: The baby Hippo with big hammer
text: Bippo the Baby Hippo. He doesn't remember a lot from his past, and is here for a big adventure!

name: Sigismund
text: Sigismund is the cousin of Max, and one of the crusaders in the Order of the Black Cloak.

name: Ninos
text:
Rumours say that he can change into a lot of persona's but nobody really knows what his true face is like its an enigma

Dead during operation judgement

name: Alice
text: Alice is often insulted as schizophrenic, for seeing a person called Hather who is not there. She also seems connected to the feywild, and to something else darker…

name: JK
text: JK is not his real name. His name and existence is a lot more real than one might think.

name: Thalia Veil
text:
She is a doctor who became a tad bit disturbed after she lost a patient to something from beyond this realm.

Dead during operation judgement

name: General Tzayad
role: Representative of the order of The Black Cloaks
text: Tzayad was sent here shortly after Tower Fall, and is the general commanding officer of the Eagle's Hope Operation. He can not enter the zone himself.

name: Tyler the Harp
text: 200 years ago, Tyler played for king Hameth as royal harpist. Before a rather large show, he broke his hand, and was sent to doctor Marrow to get his hand fixed. That is the last he remembers before becoming a harp, and playing for the pleasure of some sickly presence in the castle under eagle’s hope for 200 years. He was eventually rescued by the Explorers hired by the Black Cloak Order.

name: The ticketmen
role: Ticket checkers at the chariot train
text: These robots were found in the castle underneath Eagle’s Hope, guarding the black and white Chariot Trains. They appear to be fully clockwork, holding strange explosive weapons. They sell and check the tickets of passengers, and keep the order in the trains.

name: Jane Ursa
text: Jane was hired to investigate the temporal effect in Eagle’s Hope. She dubbed this effect: the Sandwalker Effect.

name: Dave the Mushroom
text: Dave is a problematic mushroom guy who works a day job down in the industrial district. He completely cleaned out Adalin Darkfeather's home and immediately fled into the swamp district to trade the stolen valuables—including a gold heart necklace—to Fairy Frenzy and drug dealer Lou Baba in exchange for cheap narcotics. He is currently targeted by a bounty.

name: Roghar
text:
Roghar was the legendary ancient Head Forgemaster of the castle under Eagle's Hope whose metallurgical innovations laid the foundation for modern weapon breakthroughs. He also ran a large subterranean restaurant within the Copper Halls. He used to work for the legendary architect Norex Volcron.

He was discovered assassinated at his private office desk following a localized gas line sabotage, with his final correspondence exposing his deep distrust of an entertainment construct sent to him by Fierre Laughingman.

name: Mister Sun
text: A horrific, lethal entertainment construct engineered from designs linked directly to Fierre Laughingman of Crescent Hills. Originally pitched as a novelty dining attraction for the King, the automaton functioned as an infiltration assassin, violently tearing its way out from inside Head Forgemaster Roghar's corpse to ambush the Black Cloak expedition crew. It sustained heavy structural damage before the surviving agents fled the sector.

name: Purvi
text: Purvi is a nimble tabaxi rogue who recently joined the Black Cloak expedition vanguard for Operation Judgement. Utilizing his advanced stealth capabilities to scout the vacant kitchens of the Forgemaster's restaurant, he was the last team member to interface with Roghar alive, receiving a bottle of ouzo from the ancient dragonborn.

name: Colin
text: Colin is an enigmatic changeling 'adult' entertainer and spiritualist who reinforced the Black Cloak investigation squad during their second deep delve into the castle. Colin survived the catastrophic chemical gas trap and the ensuing combat encounter against the Mister Sun automaton within the Copper Halls restaurant.

name: Elixis Holion
text: Elixis is a sharp, highly accomplished tiefling lawyer operating across the entire Eagle's Hope County area. She is widely renowned for her specialized legal work handling the complex, often chaotic liabilities of high-profile adventuring parties and prestigious knightly guilds, counting both the Order of the Black Cloak and the Order of the Blue Rose among her elite clientele. She recently intervened to cleanly resolve the Crescent Hills crew's outstanding town guard warrants following a house-breaking incident.

name: King Zohar Hemmeth I
role: Former King of the Hemmeth Empire
text: King Zohar Hemmeth I was the final ruling monarch of the grand Hemmeth Empire, whose reign ended catastrophically in 889 when his towering castle was mysteriously swallowed whole by the earth.

name: RayRay
text: A famous zoologist who used to give prestigious lectures at the Graveseal Academy in Red Tail, but recently went missing near the mysterious city of Sha Isfet within the harsh sands of the Condor Desert.

name: King Caspian Trident
text: The current sovereign ruling over the ocean kingdom of Tritos, a powerful aquatic civilization situated at the very bottom of the Shallow Ocean.

name: Lady Rayna Ray
text: The daughter of the missing zoologist RayRay, Rayna is an upcoming expert in the field of history who serves as the Academy's Collector of History in Red Tail. Much like her father, she possesses an intense passion for expeditions and is unafraid to get her hands dirty in the field. She claims to have unearthed concrete information explaining exactly what the underground castle is and why it was buried.

name: Prince Erythros Triton
text: The younger son of King Caspian, Prince Erythros is highly knowledgeable about both the surface world and the deep sea due to his extensive academic studies in Manta Bay. Knowing that he cannot inherit the throne of Tritos, he is deeply motivated to be remembered for another grand, historically significant achievement. He is currently traveling to Peregrine to negotiate the creation of an independent exploration organization that can operate alongside the Black Cloaks.

name: King Alexander von Algar
text: King Alexander became king by taking his family's fortune, buying loyalty, and making pacts with other noble houses, eventually conquering all divided houses and kingdoms back into a single realm. When he waged war, he was always at the front of the lines, getting burned and stabbed, but nothing could kill him. After years of ruling without aging, defying all human expectations, the people began calling him the Immortal King. He has ruled over the kingdom since 932.

name: Julia Heliotrop
text: Julia Heliotrop works as a sharp, secretive informant and the newly appointed Guildkeeper of the Wonderless Timing Guild. She has recently partnered with Alice and Bippo in Peregrine to help guide their independent operations.

name: Jack Lemon
text: Jack Lemon is the mysterious, high-ranking operative responsible for compiling the heavily classified tactical field intelligence reports regarding the Sandwalker anomaly and the political unrest of Crescent Hills. Operating closely with high nobility and military commands, Lemon monitors anomalous readings, tracks suspicious player entities, and brokers back-alley data deals—such as his recent transaction to purchase Alice's raw mission logs from Peregrine. While his ultimate allegiances remain entirely obscured, his investigative reach spans the entirety of Eagle's Hope County.
